website_summary.name: Monthly Sales Dashboard Viewer
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and interactive dashboard for viewing monthly sales data through a bar chart, complete with filters for selecting time ranges.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a minimalist design with a white background and gray accents. At the top, there is a header displaying the title "Monthly Sales Dashboard" alongside status indicators such as "Online" and the last sync timestamp. Below the header, there are two dropdown menus for selecting the time range ("Last 7 Days", "Last 30 Days", etc.) and the chart view ("Daily", "Weekly", "Monthly"). The main section showcases a responsive bar chart illustrating daily sales data over the selected period. The bars are colored in a vibrant blue, making them stand out against the neutral background. Beneath the chart, a summary section provides key metrics like total sales, average daily sales, and the highest sales day. The overall layout is well-organized, ensuring easy readability and navigation.
website_summary.functionality: The website offers several functionalities aimed at managing and analyzing sales data. Users can choose a specific time range via a dropdown menu to customize the data displayed in the bar chart. Another dropdown allows users to switch between different chart views (daily, weekly, monthly). The bar chart dynamically updates based on the selected filters, providing a visual representation of sales trends. Additionally, the data summary section at the bottom gives quick insights into total sales, average daily sales, and peak sales days. The site also supports offline functionality using service workers and stores data locally in the browser's localStorage.
